newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added temporary reserves to the banking system on Monday through overnight system repurchase agreements, a Fed spokeswoman confirmed.

Analysts had anticipated the operation, citing a firm Federal funds rate tied to pressures related to the first (business) day of the month and also to the settlement date for $23.0 billion in cash management bills.
Federal funds were trading at 5-7/16 percent, above the Fed's 5-1/4 percent target for the rate, at the time of the operation.
(( -- E. Freilich, North American Treasury Desk 212-859-1679))
